title: Pools
description: Shared credit pools (engine-spec §2 Pools: pool_id -> available). The amounts of all member cards of a pool may not exceed max(0, available_minor - the holds_uncounted_minor and reservations_minor of every member card) (engine-spec §12.3). Each pool_id at most once. Protocol v1 expresses ONE pool level (on top of the card and credit-account layers); nested pools need protocol v2 (M2) and must not be approximated by one level.

available_minor.description: Available shared capacity as reported (raw value).
